properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 3 at 8:13PM CDT until August 6 at 7:00AM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Major flooding is forecast.

- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage early
Thursday morning and continue falling to 12.8 feet Saturday
evening.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 36.2
feet on 07/20/1990.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

properties.headline: Dust Storm Warning issued August 3 at 7:23PM MST until August 3 at 9:00PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Dust Storm Warning for...
Northeastern Pima County in southeastern Arizona...
South Central Pinal County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 900 PM MST.

* At 723 PM MST, a wall of blowing dust in Tucson, moving northwest
at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Less than a quarter mile visibility.

SOURCE...Detected by National Weather Service meteorologists.

IMPACT...Dangerous life-threatening travel.

* Locations impacted include...
Tucson, Oro Valley, Marana, Davis-Monthan Air Force Base, Casas
Adobes, Drexel Heights, Flowing Wells, Tanque Verde, South Tucson,
Three Points, Avra Valley, Pascua Pueblo Yaqui Reservation,
Tortolita, San Xavier Community, Saguaro National Park West, Tucson
Mountain Park, Tucson Estates, Pinal Airpark, Valencia West and
Catalina State Park.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 19 between mile markers 57 and 63. Route 86 between mile
markers 153 and 171. Route 77 between mile markers 70 and 83.
Interstate 10 between mile markers 226 and 264.
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not drive into a dust storm. PULL ASIDE STAY ALIVE!

Dust storms lead to dangerous driving conditions with visibility
reduced to near zero. If driving, avoid dust storms if possible. If
caught in one, pull offan area the road, turn off your lights and
keep your foot off the brake.

CMAMtext: NWS: DUST STORM WARNING til 9:00 PM MST. Be ready for a sudden drop to zero visibility.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: DUST STORM WARNING for this area until 9:00 PM MST. Be ready for sudden drop to zero visibility. Pull Aside, Stay Alive! When visibility drops, pull far off the road and put your vehicle in park. Turn the lights off and keep your foot off the brake. Infants, the elderly and those with respiratory issues urged to take precautions.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 3 at 8:02PM MST until August 3 at 10:00PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
FFWTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Western Cochise County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 1000 PM MST.

* At 802 PM MST, the public reported continued flash flooding from
earlier thunderstorms across the warned area. Washes were running
high across the region with flooding impacts to continue into the
late evening. Additional rainfall will mainly be less than 0.25
inches.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Public reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Sierra Vista, Benson, Willcox, Whetstone, Huachuca City, St. David,
Tombstone, Dragoon, Pearce-Sunsites, Kartchner Caverns State Park,
Fort Huachuca, Cochise, Texas Canyon, Fairbank, Charleston, Kansas
Settlement, Muleshoe Ranch Preserve and Cascabel.

This includes the following highways...
Route 90 between mile markers 290 and 336. Route 80 between mile
markers 293 and 333. Route 191 between mile markers 43 and 66. Route
92 between mile markers 322 and 323. Interstate 10 between mile
markers 299 and 344. Route 82 between mile markers 50 and 67. Route
186 between mile markers 327 and 335.

This includes the following Flash Flood Prone Locations...
Davis Rd between HWY 80 & HWY 191.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 3 at 10:28PM EDT until August 3 at 11:30PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
properties.description:
SMWILM

The National Weather Service in Wilmington has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Waters from Little River Inlet SC to South Santee River SC from 20
to 60 NM...

* Until 1130 PM EDT.

* At 1027 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located over Long Bay
Terrace, moving north at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Long Bay Terrace, Bill Perry Junior Reef, Bp 25 Liberty Ship Wreck,
and Atlantic Ledge.
properties.instruction:
Boaters should seek safe harbor immediately until these storms pass.
If caught on the open water, prepare for deteriorating conditions.
Make sure you and your crew are wearing properly fitted life jackets.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 3 at 7:53PM MST until August 3 at 8:30PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
At 753 PM MST, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from 10
miles south of Three Points to 8 miles south of Green Valley, moving
southwest at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Sahuarita, Green Valley, Tubac, Amado, Arivaca Junction and Madera
Canyon.

This includes Interstate 19 between mile markers 23 and 43.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. These storms are capable of producing damaging winds.

Wind damage with these storms will occur before any rain or
lightning. Do not wait for the sound of thunder before taking cover.
Seek shelter immediately inside a sturdy structure and stay away from
windows.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 3 at 6:53PM MST until August 3 at 8:15PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
At 653 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing heavy
rain across much of western Cochise County. Between 1 and 2 inches of
rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Sierra Vista, Willcox, Whetstone, Huachuca City, St. David,
Tombstone, Portal, Bowie, Dragoon, Pearce-Sunsites, Chiricahua
National Monument, Kartchner Caverns State Park, Fort Huachuca,
Cochise, Sunizona, Kansas Settlement, Rucker Canyon, Texas Canyon
and Paradise.

This includes the following highways...
Route 90 between mile markers 296 and 331. Route 80 between mile
markers 296 and 328...and between mile markers 400 and 413. Route 181
between mile markers 39 and 64. Route 191 between mile markers 31 and
89. Route 92 between mile markers 322 and 323. Interstate 10 between
mile markers 309 and 389. Route 82 between mile markers 48 and 67.
Route 186 between mile markers 327 and 359.

This includes the following Flash Flood Prone Locations...
Hwy 181 at Turkey Creek.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

In hilly terrain there are hundreds of low water crossings which are
potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not attempt to cross flooded
roads. Find an alternate route.
